name: Jensen's Bermondsey Dry Gin
distillery: Bermondsey Distillery (railway arches near London Bridge)
production: Recipe described as from the 1800s / early 20th-century London Dry style
No contemporary botanicals (no cucumber, rose, grains of paradise)
history: 2005 | First bottling, initially made by Thames Distillers
2015 | February: production moved to own Bermondsey Distillery; new label
expressions: Jensen's Old Tom Gin | unsweetened Old Tom from an 1840s recipe
notes: Founder Christian Jensen was inspired by vintage gins from London's lost distilleries. Gin Guild notes distillery temporarily closed. Backlog year 2004 vs Difford's first bottling 2005 [cần kiểm tra]. Full botanical list not published on fetched pages.
